project.name: Calamum Moltbook Observer
project.description: Public observer toolkit for privacy-preserving Moltbook telemetry, guarded runtime operations, and local analysis workflows.

content_roots.assets/: Branding, visuals, and static presentation assets.
content_roots.deployment/: Deployment packaging, container assets, and service definitions.
content_roots.docs/reports/: Curated public reports and evaluation artifacts.
content_roots.src/: Observer runtime, analysis pipeline, and tests.
content_roots.template_library/: Reusable names-only templates shipped with the project.
content_roots.tools/: Project support, audit, and reporting utilities.
